messages:
mike_k: Thinking about the lifecycle for the http<->grpc adapter we discussed. Do we want it as a long-lived gateway service or a short-lived sidecar per service? main tradeoffs: quota attribution, tracing, per-tenant routing, rolling updates.

sophia_j: I'd lean sidecar for tenant isolation and simpler per-service rollout. Downsides: ops burden and more instances (cost).

ben_platform: Sidecar makes telemetry tricky: we'd need to aggregate traces and quotas across many sidecars. Gateway centralizes sampling and rate-limits, easier to apply global routing policies.

elaine_pm: From console/UX POV, customers want one place to set routing policies and see quota usage. A 'logical gateway' in console is fine even if implemented by sidecars (control plane).

mike_k: Agreed. How about hybrid: control plane for policy (single source of truth), sidecars enforce locally for latency. Gateway layer for legacy clients/edge.

sophia_j: That fits. Implementation notes: adapter should support proto passthrough and JSON transcoding. We need to decide if we store proto descriptors in control plane (yes/no).

ben_platform: Store descriptors in control plane v1. Keep them immutable per version to avoid runtime inconsistencies. Rollout: versioned descriptor bundles + canary flag.

mike_k: Rollout UX: console shows 'adapter bundle' with versions, canary percentage, health metrics, error rates, p50/p99 latency, token counts. Toggle to rollback.

elaine_pm: Also want telemetry signals for semantic errors (proto decode failures) vs gRPC-level errors — surface them separately.

ben_platform: Agree. For quotas: attribute at request origin (api-key) not at gateway IP. Sidecars must propagate x-origin headers. We need signed header to prevent spoofing.

sophia_j: Docs: snippet for sidecar config:

```
adapter:
  mode: sidecar
  control_plane: https://control.redwood.internal
  descriptor_version: v2026-03-01
  signed_origin_header: X-RD-ORIGIN
```

deploy-bot: deploy: Adapter control-plane service v0.3.0 deployed to staging at 2026-03-20T09:12Z :rocket:

mike_k: Next steps: Ben to sketch control-plane API (descriptor bundles, canary ops, signature keys), Sophia to prototype sidecar header propagation, Elaine to mock console flows. Ping when PRs ready.

sophia_j: I'll open a spike PR tomorrow. cc @ben_platform for API shape.

ben_platform: I'll draft API today. Quick question: do we support runtime transcoding config (route-level) or only per-bundle? I prefer per-route to reduce bundle churn.

mike_k: Per-route in bundle but allow dynamic overrides in control-plane for canaries. Good enough.

elaine_pm: UX note: show effective config on route page with 'overrides' section. :+1:
